encounters.cc: Multiple episodes of respiratory and ear infections with persistent cough and diarrhea

lines: Multiple episodes of respiratory and ear infections with persistent cough and diarrhea
The patient returns to Allergy and Immunology for follow-up of X-linked agammaglobulinemia diagnosed in July 2020.
He has known congenital heart disease with bicuspid aortic valve.
His parents report that he has had persistent cough, several courses of antibiotics, and recurrent diarrhea.
He was born at term after an uncomplicated pregnancy and delivery, and his growth and development were initially normal.
Since 6 months of age, he has become increasingly prone to infections and has not responded well to standard vaccines.

He has established histories of immunodeficiency and bicuspid aortic valve with stenosis as documented in prior encounters.
